title: Adjustment to Textbooks and Curriculum to De-emphasis Academic Outcomes in Schools
what_it_is: Adjustment to Textbooks and Curriculum to De-emphasis Academic Outcomes in Schools

sections.label: National curriculum four principles
sections.summary: The national curriculum is broad-based and based on four principles: holistic education, strong fundamentals, engaged learning and future readiness.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: To achieve this, the national curriculum is broad-based and based on four important principles: holistic education, strong fundamentals, engaged learning and future readiness.

sections.label: MOE textbooks support holistic development
sections.summary: MOE textbooks are aligned with curriculum objectives and designed to support students' holistic development, not just exam passing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) textbooks are closely aligned with the objectives of our curriculum and are, therefore, designed to support our students’ holistic development and not just for them to pass exams.

sections.label: Untested learning outcomes and parent concerns
sections.summary: Untested learning outcomes are emphasised in the curriculum, though parents at an award ceremony said skipping Primary 1 and 2 tuition makes catching up hard.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Even though these learning outcomes may not be tested in examinations, they are equally important aspects of development and they are given due emphasis in our curriculum.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: At a recent education award ceremony, I had quite a lot of parents coming to tell me that they find that if they do not send their children in Primary 1 and Primary 2 for tuition, they are already left out of the train, and they find it very hard to catch up.

sections.label: Teachers reminded not to over-test
sections.summary: Teachers are reminded not to over-test or over-teach, MOE supports appropriate test papers, and most students can answer most national exam questions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Teachers have been reminded not to over-test and not to over-teach.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: To that end, MOE provides support to help HODs and teachers set test papers at the level that is appropriate for students, and at the level that meets the learning objectives.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to add that, for national examinations, the majority of students will be able to answer the bulk of the questions.
